site.name: Alacoque Shaft
overview: Alacoque Shaft is a documented historic underground gold mine in Clear Creek County's Idaho Springs Mining District. Federal mineral-record data and mapped locality references preserve a stable shaft-level location for identification.

timeline.text: Federal mineral records preserve Alacoque Shaft as a past-producing underground gold site in the Idaho Springs mining district.

moreHistory: USGS MRDS record 10238507 places Alacoque Shaft near 39.75972, -105.51333 and identifies it as an underground past-producing gold property. The retained record also references Mine Map Repository file 406047. The mapped shaft locality is used for identification; Remnant does not assert that a shaft collar, hoist, headframe, foundations, or other workings survive or are accessible today.
